verdict.rationale: Microsoft's transparency note says Copilot can 'use Vision to analyze images, get insights from photos, and search visually,' which covers the core of sharing photos and having the assistant interpret them. That is a single brief first-party claim, with no detail on upload flows or accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit screenshot-sharing support, documentation of how images are uploaded and analyzed, evidence of interpretation accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
